instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched OpenStudio Application graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not run Ruby, Python, OpenStudio CLI, EnergyPlus command-line tools, shell commands, or helper scripts; do not edit OSM/OSW files directly outside the GUI. Use only OpenStudio Application GUI tools, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Single Office Shell. Work in a new blank OpenStudio model with no init files. Save result.osm in the task output folder. Create a one-story rectangular office energy model with one space named Office and one thermal zone. The completed model must contain 1 building story, 1 spaces and 1 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Office. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area. Model the enclosure with 6 OS:Surface objects, split into 1 floor surfaces, 1 roof/ceiling surfaces and 4 wall surfaces. The surface outside-boundary counts should be 1 Ground, 5 Outdoors and 0 Surface. Do not add any windows or other subsurfaces. Include 0 ideal-loads air systems, 1 zone HVAC equipment lists and 0 dual-setpoint thermostats. Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 8.00 m in X, 5.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.10 m. The total floor surface area should be 40.00 m2 within +/-0.75 m2 and the total exterior wall gross area should be 83.20 m2 within +/-0.75 m2. Other model details may vary as long as the saved OSM satisfies these stated requirements.
